messages.en: I'm in the middle of a lesson, but I missed you so much that I stopped by!!

messages.ko: 요즘 몰아치는 하루가 많아서 연락 잘 못해서 미안 ㅠㅠ
messages.en: I'm sorry I haven't been able to contact you much lately because I've had so many hectic days ㅠㅠ

messages.ko: 그치만 그사이에 재밌는 촬영들 FaustLD가 좋아할만한것들도 많이 해놨구 ㅎㅎ
messages.en: But in the meantime, I've done a lot of fun shoots, including things FaustLD would probably like ㅎㅎ
I'm working hard on my lessons tooㅓ
Since being busy makes all kinds of thoughts disappear too,
I think it's a good thing.
There's nothing left in my head but FaustLD.
I should enjoy this busy time to the fullestㅏ
They say you can sleep when you're deadㅅ
I'm very healthy though.
I think the reason I can keep going is
thanks to overdosing on vitamins.
I'm realizing the effects of supplements these days.
Make sure you really take your supplements properly,
and eat only good food too, FaustLD.
We have a tour coming up soon too,
so I'll be able to show you as many stages as I want~
Has your injury gotten much better?
Yeah, completely.
I told you,
my healing ability is something else.
Everyone around me kept saying,
It's going to scar, what are we going to do? ㅠㅠㅠ
But I think if it heals this quickly,
it probably won't scar.
I guess my skin is just like that.
It heals well,
and has good recovery power.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
Are you going to cry at this concert??
Hmm, after seeing this,
even if I start to tear up,
I don't think they'll come out.
Now that I'm conscious of it ㅋㄹㅋㅅㅋㅋ
These days, even when something really sad happens,
I only feel sad in my heart,
and the tears don't really come out.
It's interesting.
Even when I watch a sad movie,
You said Hayeon only cries when she's upset and angry.
That's right ㅋㅎㅋㄹㅋㅎㅋ
At times like that, the tears come out even when I don't want to cry.
Why do you want to see me cry!!
Do you want to make me cry??
I want to make you cry from happiness.
If that's the case, I'll shed tears of emotion.
Oh, I have to go back in.
I'll work hard on my lessonㅔ
Good nightㅏ
Haranghae🫡🫡
